title: Kamailio v5.2.6 Released
html:
Kamailio SIP Server v5.2.6 stable is out – a minor release including fixes in code and documentation since v5.2.5. The configuration file and database schema compatibility is preserved, which means you don’t have to change anything to update.

Kamailio® v5.2.6 is based on the latest source code of GIT branch 5.2 and it represents the latest stable version of this branch. We recommend those running previous 5.2.x versions to upgrade. There is no change that has to be done to configuration file or database structure comparing with the previous releases of the v5.2 branch.

Resources for Kamailio version 5.2.6

Source tarballs are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.2.6/src/

Detailed changelog:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.2.6/ChangeLog

Download via GIT:

 # git clone https://github.com/kamailio/kamailio kamailio
 # cd kamailio
 # git checkout -b 5.2 origin/5.2

Relevant notes, binaries and packages will be uploaded at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/5.2.6/

Modules’ documentation:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/5.2.x/

Thanks for flying Kamailio!

Note that this is a release from the previous stable branch. Currently the latest stable branch is 5.3, with v5.3.2 released out of it.

Do not forget to make the plans for the next Kamailio World Conference, in Berlin, Germany, during April 27-29, 2020! Three days of knowledge sharing and networking with renowned RTC experts.
